title: US faces $3.4bn hit as international enrolments fall
summary_en: Anticipated drops in international student numbers this fall are expected to cost the US $3.4bn in economic impact and 39,000 jobs, new analysis has revealed.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: US faces $3.4bn hit as international enrolments fall

title: RMIT Vietnam secures approval for new Hanoi campus and Saigon South expansion
summary_en: RMIT University has secured Vietnamese government approval to expand its operations in Vietnam, including plans for a new campus in Hanoi and the redevelopment of its existing Saigon South campus in Ho Chi Minh City.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: RMIT Vietnam secures approval for new Hanoi campus and Saigon South expansion

title: Marie Taillard, ESCP Business School
summary_en: This week, The PIE sat down with Professor Marie Taillard, UK dean of ESCP Business School. We spoke about her addiction to tea, how education is shaping the job market and the drive needed to succeed in the sector.
